stories.title: August 2026 ties for hottest month on record as global temperatures hit 1.65°C above pre-industrial levels
stories.reason: Copernicus data shows the month tied July 2023's record and pushed monthly warming back above the 1.5°C threshold for the first time since November 2025, capping western Europe's hottest summer on record.

stories.title: Indonesia's wildfire emissions surge to the world's highest amid its most intense fire season in 11 years
stories.reason: Fires in Kalimantan and Sumatra emitted 19.7 million tons of CO2 in a single week, over a third of the global total, as a strengthening El Nino puts 2026 on pace to match Indonesia's catastrophic 2015 burning season.

stories.title: BRICS summit opens in Delhi with 11 leaders as India navigates an Iran-UAE rift over the joint declaration
stories.reason: The two-day summit tests whether the bloc can present a united front on trade, currency and Global South reforms even as its own members are on opposite sides of the region's wars.

stories.title: Documentary alleging an AI targeting system enabled mass killing in Gaza gets a standing ovation in Venice; IDF rejects the claims
stories.reason: The film draws on 24 anonymous Israeli military and intelligence whistleblowers describing an AI system called 'Lavender' used to identify targets from mass surveillance data, while the IDF insists strike decisions were made only by human personnel.

stories.title: Israeli strikes escalate in southern Lebanon despite ceasefire, killing dozens including women and children
stories.reason: Peacekeepers report a marked deterioration along the Blue Line as Israel expands its military footprint in violation of a UN Security Council resolution, raising fears of a full reopening of the Lebanon front.

stories.title: AIR Security emerges from stealth with $50 million to build a firewall for AI agents
stories.reason: Backed by Sequoia and Greenoaks, the startup says it found over 17,800 public AI add-ons relying on untrusted instruction sources and skills impersonating Anthropic and OpenAI to bypass security reviews -- a preview of the agent supply-chain risks enterprises now face.

stories.title: Oil tops $105 a barrel as Iran plans Strait of Hormuz talks with Gulf states in Oman
stories.reason: Crude is up more than 8% this month and US gas prices have jumped 41% since the war began, with Monday's talks the first sign of potential diplomacy over the blockaded strait even as fighting continues.

stories.title: Lawsuit accuses DHS of systematically surveilling and intimidating people who observe ICE operations
stories.reason: Common Cause's suit describes members photographed, followed, pepper-sprayed or visited at home by federal officers after monitoring immigration enforcement, testing the legal limits of citizens' right to observe government action in public.
